title: Two compactifications over a base have a common cartesian refinement
statement: Let $S$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme and let $f\colon X\to Y$ be a morphism of $S$-schemes whose structure morphisms $X\to S$, $Y\to S$ are separated, quasi-compact and locally of finite type. A compactification of $f$ is a factorization $X\xrightarrow{i}Z\xrightarrow{p}Y$ with $i$ an open immersion and $p$ proper [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. For compactifications $c=(X\xrightarrow{i}Z\xrightarrow{p}Y)$ and $c_1=(X\xrightarrow{i_1}Z_1\xrightarrow{p_1}Y)$, an over-refinement $c\to c_1$ is a proper $S$-morphism $h\colon Z\to Z_1$ with $p_1h=p$ such that the square with sides $\mathrm{id}_X$, $i$, $i_1$, $h$ is cartesian, i.e. $h^{-1}(i_1(X))=i(X)$. Then any two compactifications $c_1,c_2$ of $f$ admit a compactification $c$ of $f$ with over-refinements $c\to c_1$ and $c\to c_2$ (take for $Z$ the scheme-theoretic closure of the image of $X$ in $Z_1\times_YZ_2$).

proof.text: From f.left ≫ Y.hom = X.hom, obtain QuasiCompact f.left by Mathlib QuasiCompact.of_comp; Y.hom is separated, hence quasi-separated. No finite-type cancellation or absolute qcqs instance is needed.

Take c = Compactification.inf c₁ c₂, the graph-image construction underlying det-nagata-refinement-common-dense. Use its already proved source-library projection refinements infFst and infSnd and cartesian squares isPullback_infFst and isPullback_infSnd in WeilConjectures.Compactification.CommonRefinement. These give precisely the pairwise part needed here, without the stronger finite-family theorem or a separate general dense-refinement argument. Each projection is proper by Refinement.isProper.

For each projection r, define its map over S by Over.homMk r.hom, using r.hom_g and associativity for the structure equation. Its equation over Y is Over.OverMorphism.ext r.hom_g. Flip the scheme pullback square and lift it through the pullback-reflecting functor Over.forget S with IsPullback.of_map. Package these data and r.isProper as OverRefinement; both witnesses are nonempty. This transport is the proved private helper nonempty_overRefinement_of_refinement.
